text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #26374a
font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #3d4a57

g.text: Input: current UAV state, latest 10 obstacle observations, previous MPC solution

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26374a
font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #25877c

g.text: 1 Predict 30 future obstacle positions from the latest 10 observations with LSTM.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #25877c

g.text: 2 Share this time-indexed forecast with MPC and DWA.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b729d

g.text: 3 Initialize/shift MPC guide; update trust from safety, progress, tracking and smoothness.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c47a27

g.text: 4 Split guided/exploratory DWA samples using trust/MPC guidance; rank by score.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c47a27

g.text: 5 Roll out candidates over the same 30-step forecast.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c47a27

g.text: 6 Retain clearance >0.25 m, corridor and braking passes; score survivors.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c47a27

g.text: 7 Choose the top safe DWA action/envelope; otherwise screen emergency actions.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b95043

g.text: 8 If none passes, stop; otherwise re-screen the selected emergency action.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b729d

g.text: 9 Re-solve MPC on the same forecast: DWA envelope normally; physical bounds in recovery.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26374a

g.text: 10 Apply screened DWA/emergency action for 0.1 s; update state/history and repeat.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #3d4a57

g.text: Output: checked next action and updated MPC guide, or a fail-closed stop
